questions.question: Which best describes the difference between marketing and selling?
questions.questionHtml: Which best describes the difference between marketing and selling?

answers.text: Marketing is digital, selling is in person
answers.textHtml: Marketing is digital, selling is in person

answers.text: Marketing earns attention and trust before contact; selling converts that trust into revenue
answers.textHtml: Marketing earns attention and trust before contact; selling converts that trust into revenue

answers.text: Marketing is free, selling is paid
answers.textHtml: Marketing is free, selling is paid

answers.text: They are the same thing
answers.textHtml: They are the same thing

questions.feedback: Marketing is everything that earns attention and trust before a customer reaches out. Selling happens once they have. Strong marketing makes selling easier.
questions.feedbackHtml: Marketing earns attention and trust; selling converts it into revenue.

questions.question: Select ALL that apply: Which are the three pillars of effective drone marketing?
questions.questionHtml: Select ALL that apply: Which are the three pillars of effective drone marketing?

answers.text: Visibility — people see you exist
answers.textHtml: Visibility — people see you exist

answers.text: Credibility — people trust your work
answers.textHtml: Credibility — people trust your work

answers.text: Clarity — people know how to hire you
answers.textHtml: Clarity — people know how to hire you

answers.text: Virality — people share your content widely
answers.textHtml: Virality — people share your content widely

questions.feedback: Visibility, credibility, and clarity work together. Virality is a vanity outcome — it does not pay the bills on its own.
questions.feedbackHtml: The three pillars are visibility, credibility, and clarity.

questions.question: Why is specialising in one customer type usually better than marketing to everyone?
questions.questionHtml: Why is specialising in one customer type usually better than marketing to everyone?

answers.text: It reduces the work you can take on
answers.textHtml: It reduces the work you can take on

answers.text: It makes marketing cheaper, sales conversations shorter, and referrals more useful
answers.textHtml: It makes marketing cheaper, sales conversations shorter, and referrals more useful

answers.text: It is required by the FAA
answers.textHtml: It is required by the FAA

answers.text: It guarantees higher prices
answers.textHtml: It guarantees higher prices

questions.feedback: A generalist competes with every other generalist on price. A specialist competes with almost no one — that is why specialising is the cheaper, faster path.
questions.feedbackHtml: Specialising makes marketing cheaper, sales easier, and referrals more useful.

answers.text: We provide high-quality drone footage at competitive rates
answers.textHtml: We provide high-quality drone footage at competitive rates

answers.text: Professional aerial photography and videography services
answers.textHtml: Professional aerial photography and videography services

answers.text: I help solar installers cut inspection time in half using thermal drone surveys, without putting techs on roofs in the heat
answers.textHtml: I help solar installers cut inspection time in half using thermal drone surveys, without putting techs on roofs in the heat

questions.feedback: The strongest value proposition names a specific customer, a specific outcome, the service, and the pain point avoided. Generic statements could belong to any operator.
questions.feedbackHtml: Specific customer + specific outcome + service + pain point avoided.

answers.text: Follower count

answers.text: Inquiries per month and the conversion rate to paid jobs
